import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String imejl = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(imejl);

        // Replace 'at' with '@'
        for (int i = 1; i < sb.length() - 1; i++) {
            if (sb.charAt(i) == 'a' && sb.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                sb.setCharAt(i, '@');
                break;
            }
        }

        // Replace 'dot' with '.'
        for (int i = 1; i < sb.length() - 3; i++) {
            if (sb.charAt(i) == 'd' && sb.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && sb.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                sb.setCharAt(i, '.');
            }
        }

        // Output processing
        for (int i = 0; i < sb.length(); i++) {
            if (sb.charAt(i) == '@') {
                System.out.print("@");
                i++;
            } else if (sb.charAt(i) == '.') {
                System.out.print(".");
                i += 2;
            } else {
                System.out.print(sb.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
        scanner.close();
    }
}
